description: How far the project's media analysis has got. Analysis runs BY ITSELF whenever media is connected. Returns percent (0-100) — 100 means nothing is OUTSTANDING, not that everything succeeded: `failed` lists items whose analysis failed (retry_analysis re-runs one) — done/total/pending item counts, runningItem {mediaRef, kind, progress}, etaSeconds (null until something has finished), blockedOnModels, and models {visual, speech}. Poll this while you wait; when blockedOnModels is above zero, call request_ai_models.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.
